title: From mansion to cultural setting
text: Amar Chand Badwa, a minister of Mewar, built Bagore Ki Haveli in the eighteenth century. The mansion’s courtyards and balconies overlook the Lake Pichola waterfront. Today its museum displays and performance spaces bring architecture into conversation with cultural practice. Museum admission and evening performances should be checked separately before visiting.
